svg.text: Schematic sketch of the village core, after the 2nd-edition plan (circa 1370 DR). Not to scale.
Farmland, paddocks and outlying farms lie beyond (not mapped)
Long Road to Red Larch (line inferred)
Positions: markers from the Forgotten Realms Wiki’s interactive map (Map:Amphail), placed over the 2nd-edition plan
in The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier (1996).
Inferred: north (the Stag-Horned Flagon article puts Ammakyl’s east and Golaund Sester’s south), the square’s outline,
and every road and lane line.
The Long Road’s line is a guess from the inns at the north and south edges and the side street east of the Flagon that meets it.
Not placed on the source map: Laughing Bandit, Ulvinhand Smithy, Elraghona Selember’s Ranch. No scale is given.
Sketched 2026-10-04 for the Faerun Economy Engine wiki. A working reconstruction, not a copy of the published map.
